title: Black Screen after returning from suspend
body: so since i got a new monitor (Samsung Odyssey G50F) my whole setup (both monitors) only show a black screen after waking from suspend (only suspend, normal booting works) if i switch tty or shutdown that wakes both up but switching tty back just freezes the screen it starting working once after i pulled out the hdmi cable (prolly a fluke tho) im using hypridle so i thought to try suspend directly without the after-sleep-cmd waking after systemctl suspend works normally then i tought the problem problem somehow came from quickshell (after-sleep-cmd is: hyprctl dispatch 'hl.dsp.global("quickshell:lockFocus")') calling ddcutil cause that had a lot of i2c error in journalctl changed ddcutilrc options to: [global] options: --disable-cross-instance-locks --max-tries 20 20 20 that didnt work so i removed every call of ddcutil in my quickshell scripts (which i got from end-4/dots-hyprland) didtn work either currently journalctl looks like this: Sep 21 19:24:22 aeki systemd-logind[689]: suspend requested from client PID 22496 ('systemctl') (unit session-3.scope)...
